titleZh: 英國外交部因間諜案召見中國大使
titleEn: UK Foreign Office summons Chinese ambassador over espionage case
summary: 文章主題是英國外交部因間諜案件召見中國駐英大使，焦點在英中之間的外交緊張與安全疑慮。全文未提供案件細節，但標題明確指向中國相關的間諜爭議。
summaryZh: 文章聚焦英國外交部因間諜案件召見中國駐英大使，反映英中外交緊張與安全疑慮。
summaryEn: The article focuses on the UK Foreign Office summoning the Chinese ambassador over an espionage case, highlighting diplomatic tension and security concerns.

titleZh: 北約欲拉攏日本參與太空計畫
titleEn: NATO Seeks to Bring Japan into Space Project
summary: 文章主題是北約試圖拉攏日本參與其太空相關計畫，並提到北約與影視界人士接觸、希望將其納入宣傳合作。全文以對北約外交與宣傳操作的批評為主。
summaryZh: 本文指出北約正試圖吸引日本參與一項太空計畫，並透過與全球影視人士接觸來擴大宣傳影響力。文章整體帶有批評語氣，認為這是北約的宣傳操作。
summaryEn: The article says NATO is trying to involve Japan in a space project and is also meeting with filmmakers worldwide to broaden its propaganda efforts. The tone is critical of NATO's outreach and messaging strategy.

titleZh: 美國NTSB新資料：中國東方航空MU5735空難疑點再起
titleEn: New NTSB Data Revives Questions Over China Eastern Flight MU5735 Crash
summary: A report citing newly released NTSB data says both fuel switches on the China Eastern Boeing 737 may have been moved to cut-off during flight MU5735, renewing questions about whether the 2022 crash was deliberate. China has not issued a final report on the disaster that killed all 132 aboard.
summaryZh: 美國NTSB新公開資料顯示，中國東方航空MU5735班機兩具發動機的燃油開關疑似被切至關閉位置，讓這起2022年墜機事故是否屬於人為造成再度引發關注。中國方面迄今尚未公布最終調查報告，空難共造成132人罹難。
summaryEn: Fresh NTSB data suggests both fuel switches on China Eastern flight MU5735 may have been moved to cut-off, renewing speculation that the 2022 crash was intentional. China has still not released a final report on the disaster, which killed all 132 people on board.

titleZh: 中歐貨運列車班次突破13萬列
titleEn: China-Europe Freight Train Trips Exceed 130,000
summary: 標題指出中國與歐洲之間行駛的貨運列車班次已突破13萬列，顯示中歐鐵路貨運持續擴張；正文幾乎全為媒體站內宣傳文字，未提供更多細節。
summaryZh: 標題指出中國與歐洲之間行駛的貨運列車班次已突破13萬列，顯示中歐鐵路貨運持續擴張；正文幾乎全為媒體站內宣傳文字，未提供更多細節。
summaryEn: The headline says the number of freight train services operating between China and Europe has exceeded 130,000, pointing to continued growth in China-Europe rail logistics. The body is mostly site promotion text and adds no further details.

titleZh: 烏克蘭冰球隊19年後重返頂級組，澤倫斯基讚揚振奮人心
titleEn: Ukraine hockey team returns to the top division after 19 years, praised by Zelenskyy
summary: The article covers Ukraine's men's ice hockey team's return to the world elite after 19 years, highlighting its strong 2026 Division I/A campaign, past decline, and symbolic importance during wartime. It also notes President Zelenskyy's congratulations and a 2024 win over China as part of the team's rise.
summaryZh: 文章報導烏克蘭男子冰球隊在2026年世界錦標賽分級賽奪得第二名，睽違19年重返世界頂級組。內容回顧球隊長期低潮與近年崛起，並提到澤倫斯基對球隊的祝賀，認為這象徵戰時烏克蘭的韌性與士氣。
summaryEn: The article reports that Ukraine's men's ice hockey team finished second in the 2026 Division I/A world championship to return to the top tier after 19 years. It reviews the team's long decline and recent rise, and notes Zelenskyy's congratulations as a symbol of wartime resilience.

titleZh: 中國重慶的世界最深天坑：小寨天坑之謎
titleEn: China’s Chongqing Tiankeng: The Secrets of the World’s Deepest Sinkhole
summary: Artykuł opisuje Xiaozhai Tiankeng w chińskim Chongqingu, najgłębszy i największy lej krasowy na świecie. Tekst omawia jego powstanie, rozmiary, odizolowany las na dnie oraz unikalny mikroklimat i ekosystem, które czynią to miejsce ważnym obiektem badań geologicznych.
summaryZh: 文章介紹中國重慶的小寨天坑，這座被稱為「天坑」的巨型喀斯特洼地是世界最深、最大的同類地形之一。內容聚焦其形成過程、深度與寬度、底部的亞熱帶森林，以及獨特的微氣候與生態系統。
summaryEn: The article presents Xiaozhai Tiankeng in Chongqing, China, as the world’s deepest and largest sinkhole. It highlights how the karst formation developed, its scale, and the isolated subtropical forest and unique microclimate at the bottom.

titleZh: 伊朗外長訪問北京
titleEn: Iranian Foreign Minister Visits Beijing
summary: 这篇文章仅明确提到伊朗外长访问北京，属于发生在中国的外交行程，但正文未提供更多关于会谈内容或东亚其他国家的实质信息。
summaryZh: 這篇文章僅明確提到伊朗外長訪問北京，屬於發生在中國的外交行程，但正文未提供更多會談內容或東亞其他國家的實質資訊。
summaryEn: The article only states that Iran’s foreign minister visited Beijing, indicating a China-based diplomatic trip, with no substantive details on talks or any broader East Asian implications.

titleZh: 中國與烏茲別克斯坦擬深化能源與資源合作
titleEn: China and Uzbekistan Plan to Deepen Cooperation on Energy and Resources
summary: 文章指出中國與烏茲別克斯坦有意深化在能源與資源領域的合作，核心內容是雙邊經貿與資源合作意向，未涉及其他東亞國家議題。
summaryZh: 文章指出中國與烏茲別克斯坦有意深化在能源與資源領域的合作，重點在雙邊經貿與資源開發合作。內容不涉及台灣、日本或南韓。
summaryEn: The article says China and Uzbekistan intend to deepen cooperation in energy and resources, focusing on bilateral trade and resource collaboration. It does not discuss Taiwan, Japan, or South Korea.

titleZh: 中國「命運共同體」在東南亞的推進與矛盾
titleEn: China’s “Community of Shared Future” in Southeast Asia and Its Contradictions
summary: The article examines China’s “Community of Shared Future” rhetoric in Southeast Asia, arguing it blends soft-power diplomacy with economic and strategic aims. It notes both Beijing’s push through BRI, digitalization, and public health cooperation, and the region’s concerns over sovereignty, debt dependence, South China Sea disputes, and ASEAN centrality.
summaryZh: 文章分析中國在東南亞推動「命運共同體」敘事，結合一帶一路、數位合作與公共衛生等議題，但也面臨南海爭端、債務依賴、主權疑慮與東協中心性等限制。
summaryEn: The article analyzes China’s push for a “Community of Shared Future” in Southeast Asia, combining Belt and Road, digital cooperation, and public health themes, but running into sovereignty concerns, debt dependence, South China Sea tensions, and ASEAN centrality.

titleZh: 白俄羅斯手球隊將赴中國參加國際賽
titleEn: Belarus Handball Team to Compete in International Tournament in China
summary: 白俄羅斯男子手球國家隊將於下週赴中國甘州參加國際賽，並與中國國家隊、中國青年隊、俄羅斯與香港隊交手。
summaryZh: 白俄羅斯男子手球國家隊下週將前往中國甘州參加國際邀請賽，賽程包含對陣中國國家隊與中國青年隊，並將對戰俄羅斯及香港隊。
summaryEn: Belarus's men's national handball team will travel to China next week for an international tournament in Ganzhou. The schedule includes matches against China's senior and youth teams, plus Russia and Hong Kong.

titleZh: 歐寶將與中國製造商合作打造新車
titleEn: Opel to Build a Car Together With a Chinese Manufacturer
summary: 文章標題提到 Opel 將與中國製造商共同打造汽車，重點在跨國汽車合作與中國供應鏈／製造參與。正文內容未提供更多實質新聞細節。
summaryZh: 文章標題提到 Opel 將與中國製造商共同打造汽車，重點在跨國汽車合作與中國製造參與。正文未提供更多實質細節。
summaryEn: The headline says Opel will make a car together with a Chinese manufacturer, pointing to cross-border automotive cooperation and Chinese industrial involvement. The body contains no additional substantive reporting.

titleZh: 中國湖南煙花廠爆炸死亡增至37人
titleEn: Death Toll in Hunan Fireworks Plant Explosion Rises to 37
summary: 中国湖南浏阳一家烟花制造厂4日发生爆炸，死亡人数升至37人，另有1人失踪、51人受伤。救援工作已基本结束，习近平要求强化全国生产场所安全管理并追责。
summaryZh: 中國湖南省浏陽一家煙花製造廠4日發生爆炸，死亡人數升至37人，另有1人失蹤、51人受傷。搜救工作已基本完成，習近平要求加強全國生產場所安全管理並追究責任。
summaryEn: An explosion at a fireworks factory in Liuyang, Hunan, China on May 4 has killed 37 people, left one missing, and injured 51. Rescue operations are mostly complete, and Xi Jinping has called for tighter safety oversight and accountability.

titleZh: 中國J-35出口型亮相　傳已簽首筆外銷合約
titleEn: China’s J-35 Export Variant Appears, Hinting at First Foreign Sale
summary: Chinese state media showcased the export-configured J-35AE stealth fighter, prompting analysts to suspect a first foreign sales deal may already be in place. The report frames the aircraft as a new Chinese attempt to compete in the global fighter market and challenge the F-35.
summaryZh: 中國官媒公開首架出口配置的第五代戰機J-35AE影像，分析人士據此推測首筆外銷合約可能已經簽署。報導指這顯示中國正加速將該型戰機推向海外市場，並與F-35展開競爭。
summaryEn: Chinese state media aired footage of the first export-configured J-35AE stealth fighter, leading analysts to suspect a first sales deal may already be signed. The report suggests China is pushing the aircraft into overseas markets to compete with the F-35.

titleZh: 美媒稱若特朗普訪中後仍無美伊協議　戰爭選項恐再度浮上檯面
titleEn: Israeli Media: If No Deal After Trump’s China Visit, War Option Returns
summary: 文章稱，美國與伊朗若在特朗普訪問中國前未能達成結束衝突的協議，軍事選項可能重新被提上桌面。白宮預計很快收到伊朗對美方新提案的回應，而特朗普計劃於5月14日至15日訪中。
summaryZh: 文章稱，美國與伊朗若在特朗普訪問中國前未能達成結束衝突的協議，軍事選項可能重新被提上桌面。白宮預計很快收到伊朗對美方新提案的回應，而特朗普計劃於5月14日至15日訪中。
summaryEn: The article says that if the U.S. and Iran do not reach a deal before President Trump returns from his planned visit to China, the military option could come back onto the table. The White House expects Iran’s response soon, and Trump is scheduled to visit China on May 14-15.

titleZh: 白俄羅斯與中國啟動旗艦及科研技術合作項目競賽
titleEn: Belarus and China launch flagship and science-technology project competitions
summary: 白俄羅斯國家科學與技術委員會與中國科技部啟動2027至2030年的旗艦科研技術項目競賽，以及2027至2029年的一般科研技術項目競賽，涵蓋人工智慧、數位經濟、先進材料、醫藥、生物技術與航太等領域。
summaryZh: 白俄羅斯國家科學與技術委員會與中國科技部共同舉辦兩項科研技術項目競賽，面向2027至2030年與2027至2029年，重點涵蓋人工智慧、工業創新、先進材料、醫藥與農工技術等。入選項目將推動前沿技術、合資企業或工業技術中心建設。
summaryEn: Belarus and China are running two joint science and technology project competitions for 2027-2030 and 2027-2029, covering AI, digital economy, advanced materials, biotech, medicine, agriculture and industrial innovation. Selected flagship projects aim to produce advanced technologies and joint ventures or industrial technology centers.

titleZh: 中國以貪腐罪判處兩名前國防部長死緩
titleEn: China Hands Former Defense Ministers Death Sentences Suspended for Corruption
summary: 中國軍事法院以貪腐罪名判處前國防部長魏鳳和與李尚福死刑，緩期兩年執行，並沒收全部個人財產、終身剝奪政治權利。
summaryZh: 中國軍事法院以貪腐罪名判處前國防部長魏鳳和與李尚福死刑，緩期兩年執行，並沒收全部個人財產、終身剝奪政治權利。
summaryEn: A Chinese military court sentenced former defense ministers Wei Fenghe and Li Shangfu to death with a two-year reprieve over corruption charges, also stripping political rights for life and confiscating their assets.

titleZh: 伊朗否認捲入霍爾木茲海峽南韓船隻事故
titleEn: Iran Denies Involvement in Strait of Hormuz Incident Involving South Korean Ship
summary: Iran denied involvement in damage to a South Korean-operated ship in the Strait of Hormuz, while South Korean authorities said the cause will be confirmed only after the vessel is towed to port and inspected. The incident remains under investigation amid U.S. accusations against Iran.
summaryZh: 伊朗駐首爾大使館否認伊朗武裝力量與霍爾木茲海峽一艘南韓公司營運船隻受損事件有關。南韓方面表示，需待船隻拖回港口並詳細檢查後，才能確認起火原因，調查仍在進行中。
summaryEn: Iran's embassy in Seoul denied any role by Iranian forces in damage to a ship operated by a South Korean company in the Strait of Hormuz. South Korean officials said the cause can only be confirmed after the vessel is towed to port and inspected, and the investigation is ongoing.

titleZh: 白俄國科學院與中國企業敲定創新合作前景
titleEn: Belarus Academy of Sciences and Chinese Firms Outline Innovation Cooperation Prospects
summary: 白俄羅斯國家科學院與中國企業代表會面，討論在創新、高科技研發及多項科研領域的合作前景，涵蓋機械工程、無人運輸、機器人系統、雷射、光學與資訊通信技術等方向。
summaryZh: 白俄羅斯國家科學院與中國企業代表會談，重點討論創新合作前景。雙方關注機械工程、無人運輸、高自動化與機器人系統、雷射、光學及ICT等領域，並強調合作需有清晰計畫與機制。
summaryEn: The Belarusian National Academy of Sciences met with Chinese company representatives to discuss prospects for cooperation in innovation. The sides focused on machinery, unmanned transport, highly automated and robotic systems, laser technology, optics, and ICT, stressing the need for clear plans and mechanisms.

titleZh: 韓國首見類人機器人參與佛教受戒儀式
titleEn: Humanoid Robot Takes Part in Buddhist Ordination Ceremony in South Korea
summary: 韓國首度有類人機器人參與佛教受戒儀式，地點在首爾曹溪宗寺院。機器人名為Gabi，穿僧袍、回答誓願問題，並依其特性接受調整後的五戒，之後還獲賜佛教法名，未來也預計參與佛誕燈節活動。
summaryZh: 韓國首度有類人機器人參與佛教受戒儀式，儀式在首爾曹溪宗寺院舉行。這台名為Gabi的機器人穿上僧袍、回答誓願問題，並接受為其特性調整的五戒，最後獲賜佛教法名，未來還將參與佛誕燈節。
summaryEn: A humanoid robot took part for the first time in a Buddhist vow-taking ceremony in South Korea, held at a Jogye Order temple in Seoul. The robot, named Gabi, wore a monk's robe, answered ritual questions, received adapted precepts, and was given a Buddhist name before an expected appearance at a Buddha's Birthday lantern festival.

titleZh: 中國表示願斡旋伊朗與美國和平談判
titleEn: China Says It Is Ready to Mediate Iran-U.S. Peace Talks
summary: 中國表示願意協助推動伊朗與美國的和平談判。中國外長王毅在北京會見伊朗外長阿拉格齊時，批評美國和以色列對伊朗的軍事行動不合法，並呼籲停火、緩和中東緊張局勢，同時希望霍爾木茲海峽航運儘快恢復正常。
summaryZh: 中國外長王毅會見伊朗外長阿拉格齊時表示，中國願協助推動伊朗與美國的和平談判，並主張停火以緩和中東局勢。中方也希望霍爾木茲海峽航運盡快恢復正常。
summaryEn: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi said China is ready to help launch and advance peace talks between Iran and the United States. During talks with Iran's foreign minister in Beijing, he called for a ceasefire, criticized U.S. and Israeli military actions, and said normal shipping through the Strait of Hormuz should resume soon.

titleZh: 白俄國營企業擴大對華出口物流能力
titleEn: Belarus State Enterprise Expands Logistics Capacity for Exports to China
summary: 白俄罗斯国营企业“БЕЛИНТЕРТРАНС”正在扩展面向中国的物流能力，以支持白俄罗斯出口。文章内容主要围绕对华运输与出口通道优化，属于经贸与物流主题。
summaryZh: 白俄國營企業“БЕЛИНТЕРТРАНС”正擴大面向中國的物流能力，以提升白俄出口效率。文章重點在對華運輸與貿易通道的優化。
summaryEn: Belarusian state enterprise BELINTERTRANS is expanding logistics capacity for exports to China. The article focuses on transport and trade channel improvements to support Belarusian outbound shipments.

titleZh: 中國外長王毅在北京與伊朗外長阿拉格齊舉行會談
titleEn: China's FM Wang Yi holds talks with Iran's foreign minister Araghchi in Beijing
summary: 中國外長王毅在北京會見伊朗外長阿巴斯·阿拉格齊，雙方就雙邊合作及伊朗與美國談判交換意見。報導還提到，會晤背景包括霍爾木茲海峽緊張局勢升溫，以及美方對相關局勢與聯合國行動的表態。
summaryZh: 中國外長王毅在北京會見伊朗外長阿巴斯·阿拉格齊，討論雙邊合作及伊朗與美國談判。報導指出，會談背景是霍爾木茲海峽緊張升溫，以及美方與聯合國相關動向。
summaryEn: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi met Iran's Abbas Araghchi in Beijing to discuss bilateral cooperation and Iran-U.S. talks. The meeting took place amid rising tension over the Strait of Hormuz and related U.S. and UN moves.

titleZh: 上海將興建全球最高無輻條摩天輪 高228公尺
titleEn: Shanghai to Build World's Tallest Spokeless Ferris Wheel at 228 Meters
summary: 上海北部宝山区将兴建一座高228米、号称全球最高的无辐条摩天轮「上海之弧」。项目预计于2026年底开工，投资约20亿元人民币，建成后将刷新目前由山东「渤海之眼」保持的同类世界纪录。
summaryZh: 上海北部寶山區將建設一座高228公尺的無輻條摩天輪「上海之弧」，預計2026年底開工，總投資約20億元人民幣。建成後將成為全球最高的同類設施，超越目前位於山東的「渤海之眼」。
summaryEn: Shanghai's Baoshan district will build a 228-meter spokeless Ferris wheel called the "Shanghai Arc." Construction is scheduled to start at the end of 2026, with an estimated cost of 2 billion yuan. It will become the world's tallest wheel of its kind, surpassing Shandong's "Bohai Eye."

titleZh: 日本校車發生交通事故，造成一人死亡
titleEn: School bus crash in Japan leaves one dead
summary: 文章報導日本發生一起校車交通事故，事件造成至少一人死亡。內文未提供更多細節，主要是一則簡短事故快訊。
summaryZh: 文章報導日本發生一起校車交通事故，事件造成至少一人死亡。內文未提供更多細節，主要是一則簡短事故快訊。
summaryEn: The article reports a traffic accident involving a school bus in Japan that left at least one person dead. It is a brief news update with no further details.

titleZh: 明斯克植物園櫻花綻放　展現日本春日文化意象
titleEn: Sakura blooms in Minsk botanical garden, highlighting Japanese spring culture
summary: 明斯克中央植物園的櫻花開放，園方介紹櫻花在日本文化中的象徵意義與相關知識，並邀請民眾前往賞花。
summaryZh: 白俄羅斯國家科學院中央植物園的櫻花近日綻放。園方介紹櫻花在日本文化中的象徵，並表示花期通常不超過一週，邀請民眾前來欣賞。
summaryEn: Cherry blossoms have bloomed at the Central Botanical Garden of the National Academy of Sciences of Belarus. The article explains sakura’s cultural symbolism in Japan and notes the bloom lasts no more than a week.

titleZh: 中國研發新型隱形巡航飛彈　射程逾1300公里引發美航母威脅疑慮
titleEn: China Develops New Stealth Cruise Missile, Raising Concerns for U.S. Carrier Fleets
summary: 文章稱中國正研發一款可裝入 J-20 與 J-35 機內彈艙的新型隱形巡航飛彈，具備低可偵測外形、紅外抑制設計，巡航速度約 0.71 馬赫，射程約 1,330 公里，意圖提升對西太平洋美軍航母打擊群的威脅。
summaryZh: 文章稱中國正研發一款可裝入 J-20 與 J-35 機內彈艙的新型隱形巡航飛彈，具備低可偵測外形、紅外抑制設計，巡航速度約 0.71 馬赫，射程約 1,330 公里，意圖提升對西太平洋美軍航母打擊群的威脅。
summaryEn: The article says China is developing a new stealth cruise missile that fits inside J-20 and J-35 weapon bays. It emphasizes low-observable design, infrared suppression, a cruise speed of about Mach 0.71, and a range of roughly 1,330 km, aimed at challenging U.S. carrier strike groups in the western Pacific.

titleZh: 盧卡申科就湖南工廠悲劇向習近平致哀
titleEn: Lukashenko Sends Condolences to Xi Over Tragic Incident at Hunan Factory
summary: 白俄羅斯總統盧卡申科就中國湖南省一座工廠發生的悲劇性事件，向中國國家主席習近平致唁電表示哀悼。
summaryZh: 白俄羅斯總統盧卡申科就中國湖南省一家工廠發生的悲劇性事件，向中國國家主席習近平表示哀悼。
summaryEn: Belarusian President Lukashenko sent condolences to Chinese President Xi Jinping over a tragic incident at a factory in Hunan Province.

titleZh: 南韓啟動KF-21戰機量產，國產防務工業邁入新階段
titleEn: South Korea Begins Serial Production of the KF-21 Fighter Jet
summary: The article reports that South Korea has begun serial production of the KF-21 Boramae fighter, marking a major milestone for its defense industry. It reviews the program’s development history, costs, domestic parts content, test progress, weapons fit, export prospects, and future upgrades toward a Block 3 stealth-capable variant.
summaryZh: 文章指出，南韓已於2026年展開KF-21 Boramae戰機量產，象徵其國防工業從研發走向實戰部署。內文回顧了開發歷程、測試成果、成本、國產化比例、武裝配置與出口前景，並提到未來將升級至更接近第五代戰機的Block 3版本。
summaryEn: The article says South Korea has started serial production of the KF-21 Boramae in 2026, signaling a shift from development to deployment. It reviews the program history, testing, costs, domestic content, weapons fit, export prospects, and the planned evolution toward a Block 3 stealth-capable version.
keywordTermsZh: 主動電子掃描陣列雷達

titleZh: 習近平呼籲全力投入煙火工廠爆炸救援
titleEn: Xi Jinping Calls for Full Rescue Efforts After Fireworks Factory Explosion
summary: 中國一座煙火工廠發生爆炸後，習近平呼籲動員一切力量展開救援工作。本文重點在於事故發生後的應急處置與救援動員。
summaryZh: 中國煙火工廠發生爆炸後，習近平呼籲動員一切力量展開救援工作，重點在事故後的應急處置與搜救行動。
summaryEn: After an explosion at a fireworks factory in China, Xi Jinping called for mobilizing all available resources for rescue work, focusing on emergency response and search operations.

titleZh: 中國湖南煙花廠爆炸釀20餘死、60餘傷
titleEn: Explosion at fireworks factory in China’s Hunan kills more than 20, injures over 60
summary: 中國湖南省瀏陽一家煙花製造廠發生爆炸，已造成20多人死亡、60多人受傷。現場仍在搜救與消防處置，兩處火藥倉庫持續構成風險。習近平要求全力救援、查明原因，並在全國加強工業安全措施。
summaryZh: 中國湖南省瀏陽一座煙花廠發生爆炸，造成20多人死亡、60多人受傷。現場持續進行搜救與消防處置，當局已劃定警戒區並疏散周邊居民。習近平要求全力救援、儘速查明原因，並強化全國生產安全管理。
summaryEn: An explosion at a fireworks factory in Liuyang, Hunan, China, killed more than 20 people and injured over 60. Rescue and firefighting efforts are ongoing, with residents evacuated from the danger zone. Xi Jinping ordered a full rescue response, a swift investigation, and tighter industrial safety measures nationwide.

titleZh: 中國湖南煙火工廠發生嚴重爆炸　至少26死61傷
titleEn: Deadly fireworks factory explosion in China's Hunan leaves at least 26 dead and 61 injured
summary: 中國湖南省瀏陽市一間煙火工廠發生爆炸，造成至少26人死亡、61人受傷。救援與搜救大致完成，當局已疏散附近居民並調查事故原因，警方也已拘留涉事公司相關責任人。
summaryZh: 中國湖南省一間煙火工廠發生嚴重爆炸，死亡人數升至26人、61人受傷。救援人員大規模投入搜救，周邊居民已被疏散，當局正調查事故原因並已拘留公司相關負責人。
summaryEn: A fireworks factory explosion in central China's Hunan province has killed 26 people and injured 61. Authorities said rescue work is largely complete, nearby residents were evacuated, and officials are investigating the cause while company leaders have been detained.

titleZh: 梅朗雄稱：特朗普想藉封鎖霍爾木茲海峽切斷對華石油，計畫已失敗
titleEn: Mélenchon: Trump Tried to Cut Off Oil to China by Blocking the Strait of Hormuz, but the Plan Failed
summary: 法國反對派領袖梅朗雄表示，特朗普對伊朗施壓、意在封鎖霍爾木茲海峽，原本是想切斷流向中國的石油供應，但這一計畫已經失敗。他並批評美國低估了全球貿易與美元體系的反作用。
summaryZh: 法國反對派領袖梅朗雄稱，特朗普對伊朗施壓並考慮封鎖霍爾木茲海峽，目的是切斷流向中國的石油，但該策略最終失敗。他還認為，美國的關稅與貿易施壓難以達到預期效果。
summaryEn: French opposition leader Jean-Luc Mélenchon said Trump’s confrontation with Iran was meant to block the Strait of Hormuz and cut off oil flowing to China, but the plan failed. He also argued that tariff pressure and trade coercion would not deliver the desired results.

titleZh: 「大石頭」園區新駐企將設立慢性病治療中心
titleEn: New resident of Great Stone park to establish chronic disease treatment center
summary: БЕЛТА сообщает о регистрации нового резидента в индустриальном парке «Великий камень». Компания из Китая и Беларуси создаст центр профилактики и лечения хронических заболеваний, а в рамках роуд-шоу в Шэньчжэне и Гонконге были подписаны новые стратегические соглашения.
summaryZh: 白俄羅斯《Belta》報導，「大石頭」工業園區新登記一家公司，將設立中白慢性病綜合預防與治療中心。相關推介活動在深圳與香港舉行，並促成多項戰略合作與意向協議簽署。
summaryEn: Belta reports that a new resident has registered in Belarus's Great Stone industrial park and will build a China-Belarus center for comprehensive prevention and treatment of chronic diseases. The Shenzhen and Hong Kong roadshow also led to several strategic cooperation agreements.

titleZh: 中國在荷姆茲海峽的策略：為何航母與潛艦不是關鍵？
titleEn: China’s Hormuz Strait Strategy: Why Are Carriers and Submarines Not the Key?
summary: 文章分析中國在荷姆茲海峽危機中的做法，指出北京並未派遣軍艦，而是透過與伊朗的能源與經濟關係維持自身利益。作者認為，中國展現的是不依賴航母或潛艦的區域影響力，也凸顯美國海軍手段的限制。
summaryZh: 本文認為，中國在荷姆茲海峽危機中沒有靠軍艦介入，而是依賴與伊朗的能源貿易與雙邊安排來維持影響力。作者把這視為北京在不承擔海上護航義務下，保護核心利益的示範。
summaryEn: The article argues that China did not respond to the Hormuz crisis with warships, but instead relied on energy trade and bilateral ties with Iran to preserve its interests. It presents this as evidence of Beijing’s regional leverage without direct naval deployment.

titleZh: 中國正在複製美國？從門羅主義看北京如何在亞洲建立區域控制
titleEn: Is China Copying America? A Monroe Doctrine in Mandarin and Beijing’s Push for Asian Control
summary: 文章主張，中國軍力不是為了全球投射，而是為了在亞洲建立區域拒止優勢，重點涵蓋台灣、南海與第一、第二島鏈。作者認為北京以 A2/AD、反艦飛彈與海上拒止能力，讓周邊戰區對美國與區域經濟體變得過於昂貴。
summaryZh: 文章認為中國軍力設計的重點不是全球霸權，而是以台灣與南海為核心，透過 A2/AD、反艦飛彈與海上拒止能力，讓亞洲關鍵戰區對對手變得昂貴且難以介入。
summaryEn: The article argues that China is not building a global power-projection force but a regional denial strategy centered on Taiwan and the South China Sea. It says A2/AD, anti-ship missiles, and naval denial are meant to make Asia's key theaters too costly for rivals to contest.

titleZh: 中國法院裁定：企業不能因導入 AI 就解僱員工
titleEn: Chinese Court Rules Workers Cannot Be Fired Solely for AI Adoption
summary: 杭州法院裁定，企業不能僅因導入人工智慧就解僱員工。涉案技術公司在以 AI 取代質檢職務後，要求員工降職並減薪 40%，遭拒後將其解雇，最終法院判員工勝訴並建議企業以培訓與轉崗替代裁撤。
summaryZh: 杭州法院裁定，企業不能僅因人工智慧取代工作而單方面解僱或降薪。案件中，一名品質檢查員工在 AI 接手後遭降薪 40%，拒絕轉崗後被解雇，法院判決公司違法並建議以培訓與再就業安排取代裁員。
summaryEn: A Hangzhou court ruled that companies cannot unilaterally fire or cut pay simply because AI replaces a worker’s job. In the case, a quality-control employee was offered a 40% pay cut after AI took over his role, then dismissed after رفضing the transfer. The court sided with the worker and urged retraining instead of layoffs.

titleZh: 賴清德出訪史瓦帝尼惹怒北京　中方怒斥違反一中原則
titleEn: Lai Ching-te's Eswatini Visit Draws Beijing's Anger Over One-China Principle
summary: 中國強烈批評台灣領導人賴清德出訪史瓦帝尼，指責其宣揚台獨並違背一中原則。賴清德則表示此行是為確認雙邊長期友誼，強調台灣不會因外部壓力而退縮。
summaryZh: 中國譴責台灣領導人賴清德出訪史瓦帝尼，稱其為分裂主義行徑並重申一中原則。賴清德則表示此行旨在維繫台史長期友誼，並強調台灣將持續與世界合作。
summaryEn: China condemned Taiwanese leader Lai Ching-te’s visit to Eswatini, calling it separatist behavior and reiterating the one-China principle. Lai said the trip was meant to reinforce long-standing ties and vowed Taiwan would keep engaging with the world.

titleZh: 無聲的超級大國競爭：中國避免與美國正面衝突，但代價可能巨大
titleEn: The Quiet Superpower Rivalry: China Avoids Direct Conflict with the U.S., but the Cost Could Be Huge
summary: 文章分析中國在2026年面對美國與其他危機時的克制姿態，認為北京傾向避免直接對抗，改以長期競爭、維持對話與鞏固內部穩定來累積優勢，同時也指出中國對外部能源與市場的依賴帶來地緣脆弱性。
summaryZh: 文章分析中國在面對美國時採取克制與長期競爭策略，強調北京優先維持國內穩定與經濟成長，但其能源與外部供應依賴也使這一策略存在脆弱性。
summaryEn: The article argues that China is avoiding direct confrontation with the United States and instead pursuing a long-term strategy built on domestic stability and economic growth. It also warns that China's reliance on external energy and supply lines leaves it geopolitically vulnerable.

titleZh: 中國接任聯合國安理會輪值主席　五月聚焦中東、烏克蘭、非洲與波黑議題
titleEn: China Takes UN Security Council Chair in May, with Debates on the Middle East, Ukraine, Africa and Bosnia
summary: China will chair the UN Security Council in May and lead several debates on global security, including the Middle East, Ukraine, Africa, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and North Korea. The agenda also includes meetings on civilian protection, sanctions, Libya, Syria, Lebanon, and other crises.
summaryZh: 中國將在五月擔任聯合國安理會輪值主席，主導多場涉及全球安全的辯論，議題涵蓋中東、烏克蘭、非洲、波黑與北韓等。會期內也將討論平民保護、利比亞制裁、敘利亞、人道議題與黎巴嫩情勢。
summaryEn: China will chair the UN Security Council in May and oversee multiple debates on global security, covering the Middle East, Ukraine, Africa, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and North Korea. The month also includes sessions on civilian protection, Libya sanctions, Syria, Lebanon, and humanitarian issues.

titleZh: 特朗普：我相信這次訪華會很成功
titleEn: Trump says he believes his upcoming China visit will be excellent
summary: 特朗普表示，他即將對中國進行的訪問將會「很棒」，並稱屆時可能會與中國國家主席習近平會面。報導稱，此行定於5月14日至15日，這將是他自2025年1月重返白宮以來首次訪華。他還說自己可能出席6月在法國舉行的G7峰會。
summaryZh: 特朗普表示，他即將對中國的訪問將會「很棒」，並稱可能會與習近平會面。這將是他自2025年1月重返白宮後首次訪華，行程訂於5月14日至15日。
summaryEn: Trump said his upcoming trip to China will be excellent and that he may meet Xi Jinping. The visit is scheduled for May 14-15 and would be his first trip to China since returning to the White House in January 2025.

titleZh: 台灣發生5.8級地震　台北與基隆附近無災損通報
titleEn: Magnitude 5.8 Earthquake Strikes Taiwan Near Taipei and Keelung
summary: A magnitude 5.8 earthquake struck Taiwan, with the epicenter reported 97 kilometers deep, 53 kilometers from Taipei and 40 kilometers from Keelung. No damage was reported.
summaryZh: 台灣發生規模5.8地震，震源深度約97公里，震央位於台北以東53公里、基隆以南40公里。目前未有財損或人員傷亡通報。
summaryEn: Taiwan was hit by a magnitude 5.8 earthquake with a focal depth of 97 km. The epicenter was reported 53 km from Taipei and 40 km from Keelung, and no damage has been reported.

titleZh: 聯合國安理會聚焦北韓導彈與制裁，南韓、日本與中國交鋒
titleEn: UN Security Council Focuses on North Korea Missiles and Sanctions as South Korea, Japan and China Clash
summary: Na sednici Saveta bezbednosti UN više država je raspravljalo o severnokorejskim raketnim testovima, sankcijama i saradnji Pjongjanga sa Moskvom. Južna Koreja i Japan su osudili pretnje i kršenja rezolucija, Kina je pozvala SAD na deeskalaciju, a Severna Koreja je ponovo odbacila sankcije i vojne vežbe SAD i Južne Koreje.
summaryZh: 聯合國安理會就北韓飛彈試射、核計畫與制裁問題展開討論。南韓、日本與美國批評平壤及其與莫斯科的軍事合作；中國則呼籲美國停止挑釁性軍演並承認歷史責任。北韓則稱制裁非法，指責美韓軍演是錯誤之舉。
summaryEn: The UN Security Council discussed North Korea’s missile tests, nuclear program, and sanctions. South Korea, Japan, and the US criticized Pyongyang and its military cooperation with Moscow, while China urged Washington to stop provocative exercises and accept historical responsibility. North Korea rejected sanctions as illegal and condemned US-South Korea drills.

titleZh: 分析稱美軍 F-22 對華威懾效果受限，南海與呂宋海峽部署引關注
titleEn: Analysis: U.S. F-22 Effectiveness Against China Questioned as South China Sea Patrols Draw Attention
summary: 文章分析美军F-22在菲律宾巴萨基地周边与南海、吕宋海峡的行动，指出这类部署延伸了对中国的军事施压。文中也提到“Cope Thunder 26-1”演习展示了美菲联合作战与前沿基地起降能力，但对轻型战机在高强度冲突中的适用性提出质疑。
summaryZh: 文章指出，美軍F-22自菲律賓巴薩基地出動，靠近南海與呂宋海峽，藉此把軍事壓力延伸到第一島鏈。文中援引“Cope Thunder 26-1”演習，稱美菲可提升聯合作戰與前沿部署能力，但也質疑相關戰機在高強度衝突中的效能。
summaryEn: The article says U.S. F-22s operating from Basa Air Base in the Philippines flew near the South China Sea and Luzon Strait, extending military pressure across the first island chain. It cites Cope Thunder 26-1 as proof of U.S.-Philippine integration, while questioning whether such fighters are effective in a high-intensity conflict with China.

titleZh: 王毅：在習近平與川普領導下 中美關係總體穩定
titleEn: Wang Yi: Under Xi and Trump, China-U.S. ties remain generally stable
summary: 王毅與美國副總統魯比奧通話，稱在習近平與川普的領導下，中美關係總體保持穩定。雙方同意維持溝通、尊重彼此、妥善處理分歧，並推動戰略穩定；王毅同時強調台灣問題是中美關係最敏感、最具風險的議題之一。
summaryZh: 王毅與魯比奧通話時表示，在習近平與川普的領導下，中美關係整體保持穩定，雙方應加強溝通、擴大合作並妥善處理分歧。王毅並稱台灣問題是中美關係中最敏感且最具風險的議題。
summaryEn: Wang Yi said in a call with Vice President Marco Rubio that China-U.S. relations have remained generally stable under the leadership of Xi Jinping and Donald Trump. He urged both sides to maintain communication, expand cooperation, and handle differences properly, while stressing that Taiwan is the most sensitive risk point in bilateral ties.

titleZh: 日本要求霍爾木茲海峽自由通行　高市呼籲德黑蘭提供安全保證
titleEn: Japan Seeks Free Passage Through the Strait of Hormuz; Takaichi Urges Tehran to Ensure Safety
summary: Japanska premijerka Sanae Takaiči razgovarala je s iranskim predsednikom i zatražila bezbedan prolaz brodova kroz Ormuski moreuz. Japan podržava brzi nastavak pregovora SAD i Irana i ističe važnost energetskih tokova kroz moreuz.
summaryZh: 日本首相高市早苗與伊朗總統通話，要求伊朗盡快確保各國船舶可安全通過霍爾木茲海峽。日方也希望美伊恢復談判，以緩和中東局勢並保障日本能源運輸。
summaryEn: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi spoke with Iran's president and urged Tehran to ensure safe passage for ships of all countries through the Strait of Hormuz. Japan also called for renewed U.S.-Iran talks to ease tensions and protect energy shipments.

titleZh: 美國高超音速飛彈「Dark Eagle」曝光：被視為對中國與俄羅斯的反制武器
titleEn: U.S. hypersonic missile Dark Eagle spotlighted as a counter to China and Russia
summary: 文章介紹美國高超音速飛彈「Dark Eagle」的能力、研發背景與可能部署考量，重點在以遠程精準打擊對抗中國與俄羅斯推動的反制能力，並延伸到對伊朗的實戰運用設想。
summaryZh: 文章分析美國高超音速飛彈「Dark Eagle」的研發與作戰用途，指出其設計初衷是回應中國與俄羅斯的先進武器發展，並可能被部署到中東，用於對高價值目標的深度打擊。
summaryEn: The article examines the U.S. hypersonic missile Dark Eagle, its development path, and its intended role as a response to China and Russia’s advances. It also says the system could be deployed in the Middle East for deep strikes against high-value targets.

titleZh: 台灣再成緊張焦點：北京指責東京煽動印太陣營對抗
titleEn: Taiwan Again at the Center of Tensions as Beijing Accuses Tokyo of Fueling Bloc Confrontation in the Indo-Pacific
summary: Kina je optužila Japan da pod izgovorom slobodnog i otvorenog Indo-Pacifika gradi zatvorene bezbednosne i političke blokove. Peking je reagovao na planove premijerke Sanae Takaiči da u Vijetnamu i Australiji promoviše obnovljeni indo-pacifički pristup, dok su napetosti između Kine i Japana dodatno pojačane zbog Tajvana.
summaryZh: 中國指責日本以「自由開放的印太」為名，實際上推動排他性的政治與安全陣營。這場爭端與日本首相高市早苗的印太新構想有關，且中日關係近月又因台灣問題進一步惡化。
summaryEn: China accused Japan of using the “free and open Indo-Pacific” concept to promote exclusive political and security blocs. The dispute comes as Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi prepares to promote Japan’s updated regional approach, while tensions over Taiwan continue to strain China-Japan ties.
